name: Graphify (Code & Knowledge Graph)
description: Visualizes project files and structural dependency graphs with interactive HTML & markdown reports.
ai_instructions: To analyze and graph project dependencies, run 'python tools/graphify.py .'. This generates an interactive visual graph at 'graphify-out/graph.html', raw graph data at 'graphify-out/graph.json', and an architectural summary at 'graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md'. Review God Nodes and community hubs before modifying large architectures.
